# Benefits of becoming a registered OVSE
![generate-virtual-id.svg](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/generate-virtual-id.svg)
Option to verify complete or selective Aadhaar verified credentials
![Service-icons-ovse.svg](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Service-icons-ovse.svg)
Quick & seamless integration with Aadhaar application
![Service-icons-clock.svg](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Service-icons-clock.svg)
Improved efficiency and reduced operational costs
![Service-icons-finger-print.svg](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Service-icons-finger-print.svg)
Secure offline verification with savable output
![Service-icons-cards.svg](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Service-icons-cards.svg)
Proof-of-presence with offline face verification
![Service-icons-cardboard.svg](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Service-icons-cardboard.svg)
Lower compliance burden
Instructions to Entities applying for OVSE Registration
Entities seeking registration as an Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE) to perform offline verification of Aadhaar number holder for lawful purpose may apply to the Authority in the prescribed application form.   
  
For Any Clarification/support reach out to: 
Click here: [to read the Aadhaar (Authentication and Offline Verification) Regulations, 2021 (as amended in 2025).](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-06/Regulation.pdf)
